action.content: Compose a poem all in lowercase letters about my friend Barnet.
action.label: context

action.content:
[DRAFT]
softly falls the evening light
on barnet's gentle, peaceful sight
a friend so kind, so true of heart
a companion from the very start

his laughter echoes, contagious and free
a joy that's contagious, a sight to see
barnet's smile, a work of art
a treasure to behold, a gentle start

in quiet moments, he's a listening ear
a friend who's always there, without a fear
barnet's presence, a comforting sight
a beacon of hope, in the dark of night

his heart is full, his spirit bright
a shining star, on a cloudy night
barnet, dear friend, a treasure rare
a gem that's precious, beyond compare.
